name: Pyromancer: Hellscape and Perpetual Burning lengthen Blaze (#1094, #1245)
contract: #1094, #1245: Blaze 805500 has a 15000 ms duration (DBC duration idx 8). Hellscape 706886 is a passive SPELLMOD_DURATION (misc 1) +3999+1 = +4000 ms on class mask A 0x200 (Blaze ranks). Perpetual Burning 707503 raises the flat DURATION modifier carried by the Ember resource aura 807533 (mask A 0x200, base 0) from 0 to +1000 ms; the aura amount is multiplied by its stack count (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:652), giving +1000 ms per Ember held. Aura::CalcMaxDuration applies SPELLMOD_DURATION (SpellAuras.cpp:811-812). Asserts the native duration modifier applied to Blaze's 15000 ms: 19000 with Hellscape, then 20000 and 21000 with Perpetual Burning and 1 and 2 Embers. Ember stacks are set with set_aura; the maximum stack count of Ember is not recorded in the audit report, so 2 stacks is the least assumed.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Perpetual Burning adds 1 s with 1 Ember
Perpetual Burning adds 2 s with 2 Embers
